name: variable-textarea
title: Variable textarea
description: A template box with an Insert variable menu: pick first_name and the token lands at the caret, with a preview that fills in sample data.
docs: value and onValueChange speak the raw template, always, also while the preview is showing. variables is a list of { key, label, sample }, where a key is letters of any script, digits, underscores, dots and hyphens (no spaces); delimiters is the pair around a key (["{{", "}}"] by default, ["%", "%"] works too). Insert variable opens the house dropdown with each label, its token and its sample; choosing one puts the token where the caret was, in place of any selection (at the end if the text never had the focus), through the browser's own editing so undo takes it out, and returns the focus to the text. The Preview toggle (preview, defaultPreview and onPreviewChange when you want to drive it) swaps the text for the same message with every sample filled in. A variable that is written but was not passed is flagged in words ({{frist_name}} is not a variable) with the nearest real one offered, and the text carries aria-invalid. maxLength limits the raw template and disables a variable that no longer fits, saying how many characters it needs. labels renames every phrase, the name the text has for a screen reader included. parseTemplate and fillTemplate live in variable-textarea/tokens.
